name: RTX 5070: Llama 3.1 8B Q4_K_M decode tokens/sec
methodology: llama.cpp CUDA backend, batch size 1, 512 token prompt, 128 token output, Q4_K_M quantization, 12GB VRAM
notes: RTX 5070 with 12GB GDDR7 at 672 GB/s. An 8B model at Q4_K_M requires ~5GB of VRAM, fitting comfortably. The 672 GB/s bandwidth yields high decode throughput for small models. The RTX 5070 is best suited for models up to ~13B at Q4_K_M or ~7B at Q8_0.
